source_builds.controller_policy: One coordinated staged build; do not stack controllers from separate builds

coordinate_system.origin_name: southwest tile centre of complete construction rectangle
coordinate_system.conversion: display X = authoring east metres / 16 + 7; display Y = authoring north metres / 16 + 13
coordinate_system.origin_note: The southwest tile centre is implicit (X0,Y0) in every view. It is retained here for projection only; no global origin marker or caption is drawn. origin_m remains the unchanged authoring/model reference, not a verified mouse-click anchor.
coordinate_system.display_axes: X increases east/right; Y increases north/up on the north-up plan

render_source_build.policy: Supply the explicitly verified V4 staged build containing these14required types; exact input fingerprints are retained in evidence/render.json.

baseline.policy: Use the approved current physical layout and current resource contract; original atomization eligibility remains recorded history.

standalone_piece_preview_policy: One canonical 0-degree angled image per type; new types also have a top view, all on their own southwest-zero local X/Y grid. P labels belong only to the assembly plan and guide.

redesign_scope.policy: An original tail deviation strictly below 5 mm selects a candidate. Actual adjoining-collar movement is independently bounded at 24.5 mm for paired junctions and 8.2 mm for one-way curves. Preserve the outside layout and supports.

metadata_cleanup.scope: Removed obsolete predecessor references from non-rendered metadata only.
